name: split-layout
title: Split layout
line: You share the frame with your B-roll, pictures, screens or a line, the layout changing on your cuts or sentences
card: You and your B-roll sharing the frame
do: split the frame with my B-roll in
say: put me in a panel at the bottom with my b-roll on top
split screen me and my footage
put my screen recording above me
me on the left and my notes on the right
picture in picture with me in the corner
switch the layout on every cut

askeditor.why: drag a panel's edge, swap a clip or move a switch on the canvas, without rendering again
